node.summary: National and international days and anniversaries.

facts.text: The **World Day Against the Death Penalty** is observed on **10 October**.
facts.plain: The World Day Against the Death Penalty is observed on 10 October.
keys: World Day Against the Death Penalty

facts.text: From the archives (4 Nov 1976): **Jimmy Carter** was elected the **39th US President**, defeating Gerald Ford, the only President never elected to the office or the vice-presidency.
facts.plain: From the archives (4 Nov 1976): Jimmy Carter was elected the 39th US President, defeating Gerald Ford, the only President never elected to the office or the vice-presidency.

facts.text: **National Unity Day** (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas, since **2014**) is on **31 Oct**, Sardar Patel's birth anniversary. Statue of Unity: **182 m**, inaugurated 2018.
facts.plain: National Unity Day (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas, since 2014) is on 31 Oct, Sardar Patel's birth anniversary. Statue of Unity: 182 m, inaugurated 2018.

facts.text: **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's** 151st birth anniversary fell on 31 October 2026 (National Unity Day/Rashtriya Ekta Diwas); retrospectives recalled his role integrating ~500 princely states and his post-Gandhi-assassination ban on the RSS, lifted after the RSS agreed to respect the tricolour.

facts.text: **Haryana Day**: 60 years (**Hirak Jayanti**) of Haryana; President **Droupadi Murmu** was chief guest at **Kurukshetra University**. Governor **Ashim Kumar Ghosh**, CM **Nayab Singh Saini**.
facts.plain: Haryana Day: 60 years (Hirak Jayanti) of Haryana; President Droupadi Murmu was chief guest at Kurukshetra University. Governor Ashim Kumar Ghosh, CM Nayab Singh Saini.

facts.text: **1 Nov** is foundation day for several States: **Kerala** (Kerala Piravi), **Karnataka** (Rajyotsava), **Andhra Pradesh** and **Madhya Pradesh** (all **1956**, States Reorganisation Act); **Haryana** and **Punjab** (**1966**); **Chhattisgarh** (**2000**).
facts.plain: 1 Nov is foundation day for several States: Kerala (Kerala Piravi), Karnataka (Rajyotsava), Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh (all 1956, States Reorganisation Act); Haryana and Punjab (1966); Chhattisgarh (2000).

facts.text: **31 Oct 2026**: **42nd death anniversary** of **Indira Gandhi** (assassinated 31 Oct 1984); memorial at **Shakti Sthal**. Jairam Ramesh noted **Nehru** unveiled a statue of Patel (the only one of a living person he unveiled) at **Godhra** on **13 Feb 1949**.
facts.plain: 31 Oct 2026: 42nd death anniversary of Indira Gandhi (assassinated 31 Oct 1984); memorial at Shakti Sthal. Jairam Ramesh noted Nehru unveiled a statue of Patel (the only one of a living person he unveiled) at Godhra on 13 Feb 1949.
